title: Isikhalazo Esizwakala Ngaphezu Komsindo
intro: Uzwa izwi liphuma emphakathini lapho ukucindezelwa sekuyinto evamile. Akukho ukubonakaliswa kwamandla okuphendula isikhalo; kunalokho, isikhalo esiqondile sifinyelela ku-Allah, futhi impendulo ishaya enhliziyweni yokukhulekela uqobo. Ubani owafaka leso sikhalo, yimuphi umbuzo owalandela, futhi yiliphi iqiniso elaqinisekiswa?
clues: Ngaveza leso sikhalo ngqo ku-Allah esikhalweni sami siqu.
U-Allah wezwa isikhalo futhi waphendula ngenselele mayelana nenkolelo yami.
Impendulo yabuza ukuthi ngingahluleka kanjani ukukholelwa ku-Allah, oMunye futhi oPhakeme.
Ngabe sengibuza ukuthi kungani u-Allah kufanele athande abantu abangakholwa.
Ngingu-Uzair, oqanjwe ku-Surah Az-Zukhruf njengomuntu u-Allah akuzwa ukukhononda kwakhe.

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
